نرتم (form VIII)
# نَرْتَمِ (nartami) /nar.ta.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
# نُرْتَمَ (nurtama) /nur.ta.ma/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
